chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said at the end of a hadith in which he mentions the ghusl of the deceased:

"Beware of stuffing anything into his ears. If you fear that something may emerge from the nostrils, then there is no blame upon you to place cotton over it. But if you do not fear that, then do not place anything in it."

key_terms.غُسْلَ: ritual washing, here referring to the washing of the deceased
key_terms.قُطْنًا: cotton placed for practical handling during preparation of the body

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about placing cotton in the ears or nostrils of the deceased during ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding the ghusl of the deceased and the handling of bodily openings during preparation for burial. It prohibits putting anything into the ears, while permitting the use of cotton on the nostrils only when there is concern that something may come out.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.589 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said: at the end of a narration discussing the washing of the deceased:

"Be careful not to stuff anything into the ears. However, if you fear that something may come out from the nostrils, there is no issue with placing cotton there. But if you do not fear anything coming out, do not place anything in them”.
